fact: A survey of December 2022 found the Net Collect Services electronic tax collection platform implemented in communes, but suspended after less than a year in several (Yamoussoukro, Toumodi, Bonoua), while continuing in Touba, Danané and Bassam.
title: « Net-collecte services » : nouvelle plateforme numérique de collecte des ressources propres des collectivités territoriales ivoiriennes, entre hésitation et acceptation
